## AuraView v0.3.4

Windows release of AuraView with EXE (NSIS) and MSI installers.

### Included features
- Lightweight Tauri/WebView2 browser with Local Hub for AI services
- Split view, bookmarks, browsing history, and smart address bar
- Image and video downloads with a download manager
- Built-in ad and tracker blocking
- Hardware-accelerated video playback

### Windows installers
Choose either the **EXE setup** or **MSI installer** below. Both install AuraView v0.3.4 for Windows x64 and bundle the configured video download tools and ad-blocking resources.

> Note: The installers are not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may show a warning.
